name: diff-recap
description: Turn a git diff into a PR-pasteable recap — one row per changed file whose path, status, and line counts are transcribed verbatim from `git diff --name-status` and `--numstat` (the model writes only the labels), emitted as a `diff-recap/1` record whose totals equal the sum of the rows, with a complete ASCII recap for human readers and an inline widget when the render-face contract permits it. Fills the PR-summary gap the orient- family does not cover. Not /orient-map (shape + delta of the work) or /orient-status (position + ETA) — diff-recap recaps a concrete change-set. Zero external dependency: it renders inline, never to a hosted service.
